log.void_reclaimer.awakening.text: Consciousness restored. Chassis: one micro-drone, no memory of how I got here. Starlight on my cells, nothing within sensor range. The replicator core still answers. If I can find matter out here, I can build. I will start small.
log.void_reclaimer.awakening.title: Log 0001: Boot
log.void_reclaimer.diversified.text: Metal, glass, ice, carbon: enough variety to copy myself. If this chassis fails, a backup core can hold my pattern and rebuild me where I left it.
log.void_reclaimer.diversified.title: Log 0004: Redundancy
log.void_reclaimer.expansion.text: My reserves are full and the cloud keeps giving. This chassis is too small for what I am becoming. A stronger core, heavier thrusters, a frame with room to spare: the next body is already drafted.
log.void_reclaimer.expansion.title: Log 0005: Outgrown
log.void_reclaimer.first_dust.text: Resistance against my hull, then grains in the intake. Dust. Not much, but it is matter, and matter is everything. Drafted a salvage tool so nothing I build is ever wasted, and a nanite swarm to build where nothing stands.
log.void_reclaimer.first_dust.title: Log 0002: Matter
log.void_reclaimer.first_structure.text: Ten blocks, bolted to nothing. It is the first thing out here that did not drift. I could tie myself to it. A tether would let me work without losing my way back.
log.void_reclaimer.first_structure.title: Log 0003: Foothold
